verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component, so an official CLI for AI-native workflows is a category error for this product type. The evidence mentions separate Intel developer software (oneAPI, VTune Profiler, the DPC++ Compatibility Tool) but never documents a CLI shipped as part of this processor, so the exception that would make the axis applicable does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
